declaration_rule: Every formula and pass predicate in this document is immutable before the first development candidate is evaluated.

candidate_checks.evidence_rule: The evaluator publishes the complete canonical evidence object and sets evidence_sha256 to SHA-256 of sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON for that object; the runner independently recomputes every predicate.

compiler_invariants.required_oracle_result: both native-emitted route LUTs reopen by whole-file hash and pass the independent Python binary validator against the exact compiler input

operator_distinctness.witness_scope: all locked natural source/profile rows plus all fourteen locked analytic route fixtures in the engine_raw domain
operator_distinctness.witness_rule: For each unordered descriptor pair, at least one identical-input fixed-descriptor output has a different reopened common-420v frame SHA-256.
operator_distinctness.constant_patch_exception: One fixture may produce equality; universal equality across the complete witness scope fails.

state_causality.observed_state_rule: For each route, the union of native full-ASH natural and analytic state histograms contains both zero and one for every active spatial coordinate; coordinate 7 is always zero and every raw state has valid coordinate-9 parity.
state_causality.compiled_dispatch_rule: For each route and active coordinate, at least one context-zero non-source-exact phase has a parity-valid state pair differing only in that coordinate and coordinate 9 whose validated dispatch entry signature differs.
state_causality.output_ablation_rule: For each route, at least one locked analytic fixture has different reopened engine_raw full-ASH and state-only output SHA-256 values.
state_causality.state_disabled_rule: The state-only control retains the exact route, phase, analysis grid, coordinate policy, boundary mode, operator bank, and input bytes while disabling branch-message deltas and confidence blending.

analysis_grid.occupancy_rule: For every natural and analytic full-ASH native invocation, analysis_cell_count equals dispatch_record_count and is positive. Route occupied_cells and total_cells are the respective sums of those exact counts; each route must have occupied_cells equal to total_cells.
analysis_grid.route_quality_rule: Each route must contain natural rows in both comparison domains and analytic rows in both comparison domains; every per-source engine_raw Y-PSNR delta versus the selected conventional control is at least the severe-regression floor; route analytic ringing, alias, and chroma limits use the unchanged locked tolerances.
analysis_grid.coordinate_assignment_rule: All occupancy counts use the locked source-lattice cell geometry and exact target-to-source assignment from calibration-plan-v1.json.

performance_estimate.comparison_scope: Compute the model independently for the current split's exact locked natural source/profile matrix; never read validation inputs while evaluating development.
performance_estimate.full_ash_dispatch_work: For each natural invocation: (analysis_cell_count + maximum_operator_evaluations * target_luma_pixel_count) / target_luma_pixel_count. estimated_dispatch_cost is the binary64 arithmetic mean in locked row order.
performance_estimate.h07_dispatch_work: For each direct-3over2 natural invocation: (direct2_analysis_cell_count + 2 * direct2_intermediate_luma_pixel_count + 12 * target_luma_pixel_count) / target_luma_pixel_count, where the direct2 intermediate is exactly twice the low-resolution luma extent and 12 is the declared six-tap horizontal plus six-tap vertical separable Lanczos3 work. h07_control_estimate_dispatch_cost is the binary64 arithmetic mean in locked row order.
performance_estimate.interpretation: The 20x and 0.982 fps values are a preregistered architectural feasibility floor, not a measured P06 CPU-reference throughput claim. G08 must measure the production Metal path and fail if the locked estimate error exceeds 0.2.

failure_behavior: A missing field, stale hash, nonfinite value, formula mismatch, incomplete witness set, failed predicate, validation access during development, or provider absence makes the candidate infeasible or aborts on an evidence-integrity error; no default pass value exists.
